domain_restrictions: m is an integer at least 1
when m equals 1, Alt_m_plus is the empty sequence
i ranges over the positions in Alt_m_plus, so i is between 1 and m minus 1
E_m counts permutations of the finite set 1 through m
n is an integer at least 2
j is an integer between 1 and n inclusive
in the first recurrence sum, j must be odd
in the second recurrence sum, j must be even
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: Define an alternating sign sequence Alt_m_plus of length m minus 1 that starts with plus 1 and alternates sign, with the empty sequence at m equals 1. Let E_0 be 1, and for each m at least 1 let E_m be the number of permutations of 1 through m that realize this sign pattern. Then for every integer n at least 2, E_n is equal to the sum over odd j from 1 to n of binomial(n minus 1, j minus 1) times E_j minus 1 times E_n minus j, and it is also equal to the analogous sum over even j from 1 to n.
quantifier_order: for each integer m at least 1, define Alt_m_plus
for each integer i from 1 through m minus 1, the i-th entry of Alt_m_plus is plus 1 if i is odd and minus 1 if i is even
for each integer m at least 1, define E_m as the number of permutations of the set of the first m positive integers satisfying Alt_m_plus
for each integer n at least 2, E_n equals the odd-j sum and also equals the even-j sum

variables.name: m
variables.role: parameter used to define the sign sequence and the counting number E_m

variables.name: i
variables.role: index of an entry in the sign sequence Alt_m_plus

variables.domain: length m minus 1, with the empty sequence when m equals 1
variables.name: Alt_m_plus
variables.role: alternating sign sequence starting with plus 1

variables.name: E_m
variables.role: number of permutations of the set of the first m positive integers that satisfy the specified sign pattern

variables.name: n
variables.role: index at which the recurrence is asserted

variables.domain: integers between 1 and n, with parity restricted to odd in one sum and even in the other
variables.name: j

witness_dependencies: Alt_m_plus depends only on m and the parity rule for i
E_m depends on the previously defined sign sequence Alt_m_plus for the same m
the recurrence terms for E_n depend on the values E_j minus 1 and E_n minus j
the counted permutation objects are internal to the definition of E_m and are not external free variables
there is no existential witness in the recurrence itself; it is an identity over all admissible n

statement_nl: For each integer m at least 1, let Alt_m^+ be the sign sequence of length m-1 whose ith entry is plus 1 when i is odd and minus 1 when i is even; for m=1 this is the empty sequence. Set E_0 = 1, and for m at least 1 let E_m be the number of permutations of {1,...,m} satisfying Alt_m^+. Then for every integer n at least 2, E_n = sum over odd j with 1 <= j <= n of binomial(n-1,j-1) E_{j-1} E_{n-j}, and also E_n = sum over even j with 1 <= j <= n of binomial(n-1,j-1) E_{j-1} E_{n-j}.
